role: Independent read-only reviewer, exact production final Tool/schema
treatment: Existing optional evidence-first ReviewNotes procedure plus bounded automatic/model note state, reconstructed before third turn. No expected answer preloaded.
negative_evidence: No accepted model-authored notes; final attempted anchor malformed. Baseline wrong rejection explanation, memory wrong acceptance and invalid obligation names. No factual pass.
confidence: One matched pair, uncontrolled sampling, cache/order and combined-treatment confounds; does not establish causal memory improvement or degradation.
candidate_next_increment: Existing reviewer instruction/budget guidance: record one small provisional contract/claim during inspection and revisit it before finalization; prefer anchor-free provisional hypothesis when exact coordinates are not known. Do not relax source-anchor verification or conclusion schema. Qualify prospectively before activation.

future_consumers.coding: Defer broad integration; smallest candidate is one source-anchored producer/consumer API relationship via existing coding disclosures, provisional until checked against both units. This reviewer sample does not validate coding benefit.
future_consumers.durable_memory: Do not auto-promote these reviews. First candidate is host-selected, role/snapshot-scoped episode retrieval with exact source/freshness checks. Procedural promotion requires explicit reviewed versioned playbook evidence and counterexamples.
